domain: V8 Normal-PV local model retained separately. New active High-PV affine battery model PV768..1342W, observed active command minimum to maximum; no independent grid path fit. Original ensemble retained as uncertainty.
inputClock: Observed ha_call_requested timestamp; unobserved virtual commands use the median regulator-to-request delay.

timing.propertyEqualityMeaning: HA-reported equality is not a correlated BLE write acknowledgment.

calibration.train: Log6 indices 27..86: first ~1 kW rise/fall; exclude 6 s after every missing-cycle restart.
calibration.heldout: Indices >=87: subsequent ~2 kW experiment and quiet tail. Grid checking uses declared constant-load plateaus.

limitations: No independent house load measurement: p_haus is derived from meter, PV and battery.
Grid fits assume constant effective load on the selected plateaus; delays include reporting/filtering.
Two-second samples do not uniquely identify delay, short PT1 time constants or ramp limits.
rate_up/down=1000000 W/s leaves PT1 unbounded; no physical slew limit is identified.
All missing-cycle intervals remain unscored; counterfactual controller and plant states restart there.
No AC-mode transition, charging, zero-discharge idle, battery limits or >2 kW discharge are identified by this log.
A conditional disturbance reconstruction is not a causal forecast or proof of a physical optimum.

chargingCounterfactualProtocol.execution: Complete production Node-RED Function, four outputs, causal state and accepted measurements.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.clocks: Regulator clock and independent meter/Modbus receipt times; no added double HA delay.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.gaps: Reset at every missing regulator cycle; zero weighting across gaps; six seconds initialization burn-in.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.netPower: For each model separately: observed grid minus response to recorded charge commands. Fixed across candidates.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.telemetryResidual: Observed Modbus minus recorded-command battery response; fixed residual and no-residual checks.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.syntheticNetPower: Causal physical house minus PV; reported PV can have a separate specified lag.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.energy: Left endpoint rectangular integration; this is sampled scenario energy, not an electricity-meter energy register.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.unavoidableImport: max(house_minus_PV,0), with no discharge allowed; reported separately from controller-added import.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.modelIdentity: Eight frozen charging cases; not eight independent fitted plants.
chargingCounterfactualProtocol.limits: No independent house-load meter; reconstruction is conditional. No new high-PV field validation.

pvWindowStudy.extrapolation: The separately labelled 2200 W case exceeds the observed charging calibration domain.
pvWindowStudy.recommendation: Controlled field test at active high/very-high charge; no proof of absolute import prevention.

localTelemetryCalibration.scope: Local normal-PV active charging only (PV368..604W). Low-PV charging, idle, delays, rates, meter path and high-PV dynamics are not refitted.

chargingNormalPVLocal.scope: Local normal-PV active charging only (PV368..604W). Low-PV charging, idle, delays, rates, meter path and high-PV dynamics are not refitted.

chargingHighPVLocal.scope: V8 Normal-PV local model retained separately. New active High-PV affine battery model PV768..1342W, observed active command minimum to maximum; no independent grid path fit. Original ensemble retained as uncertainty.

log10ModelDecision: No plant parameter replacement. Bias-only fit improves first ten minutes but worsens later data. Discharge battery big-step residual exceeds407W; mixed direction switching not identified. Meter dynamics remain conditional, not independently identified.
log10SimulationProtocol: Discharge only until actual charging begins; resets at missing cycles; no prediction of direction switching/charging settling. Net fixed by baseline grid plant, residual fixed across candidates. Observed outputLimit request clocks reused per cycle; virtual changed commands use median89ms. Assumed fixed transport timing across candidates, not device ACK.
log11Decision: Keep plant parameters and uncertainty ensemble. Nominal battery model fits current Normal-PV data better than Log8 local offset; no globally valid local offset established. Bias fit improves MAE but worsens RMSE. No Normal-PV controller change approved.

log11ControllerStudy.reason: Small conditional field improvements did not persist across independent noise/disturbance scenarios. No new controller version.

acceptanceFit.scope: Single identified taper episode. Activation and release supplied externally, not predicted from SOC.

physicalExportEstimate.scope: holdout of first empirically fitted acceptance episode; AC balance, not independent ground truth

parameters.scope: Single identified taper episode. Activation and release supplied externally, not predicted from SOC.

chargeAcceptanceExtension.observer: analysis_log12/acceptance_model.py; causal suspicion, not authoritative BMS state
limitations: No universal SOC-to-cap function; same SOC 98 occurs with approximately 158 and 1293 W charging.
No cell voltages, temperature or authoritative BMS allowed-charge-power measurement.
Only first taper episode fitted/chronologically validated. Short final reduction is not an independent long validation.

startup.scope: One full-standby startup event only; observed sample onset bracket, not proven actuator latency or universal timeout.

fullStandbyDischargeStartup.activation: transition from batt_max=true, zero battery power, standby packState and charging/idle direction to allowed discharge

observation.scope: One full-standby startup event only; observed sample onset bracket, not proven actuator latency or universal timeout.

fullStandbyDischargeStartup.semantics: Keep discharge output zero until release; delayed command target may update behind gate; then use unchanged normal discharge PT1 dynamics. Do not wait for packState telemetry to permit power.
fullStandbyDischargeStartup.acceptanceRecoveryAfterDischarge: unknown; retain V12 scenario-driven recovery, not permanently zero charge capacity
fullStandbyDischargeStartup.validation: Transition is calibrated on this single event; later samples check normal dynamics only, not an independent startup validation.

closedLoopACCoupling.gridEquation: P_grid = P_external_net - P_discharge_actual; sample common physical response at each sensor receive timestamp
closedLoopACCoupling.oldSeparateGridPath: retained in legacy models, not used for this local closed-loop branch; fails Log13 baseline long-horizon check
closedLoopACCoupling.uncertainty: No independently identified sensor filter. Net load reconstructed from logged grid minus signed battery power; may contain asynchronous measurement noise.

log13ParameterStudy.scope: 54 conditional closed-loop scenarios, same measured net load/PV, 3 startup gates and 2 deterministic noise levels; one full-start event, not independent field validation. Coupled AC power model uses battery response for physical grid contribution, separately sampled; old separate grid response fails baseline long-horizon check; logged flags/status reused because direction policy unchanged.
log13ParameterStudy.decision: Keep PV discharge gain 0.8 and load-step up-ramp 900 W/tick. No robust benefit established from one startup; no new controller release.

lowPowerDawnExtension.scope: Logs15/16: PV8..367W, active discharge <=90W and charge commands60..285W. Not a High-PV or full-battery recalibration.

discharge.fitOnly: bias; gain, delay, time constants and slew limits retained
discharge.trainDomain: Log15 first10min, low discharge commands; independent Log15 remainder and Log16 active discharge checks
discharge.idle: Zero-command -19 W telemetry calibrated on one Log16 interval; physical zero-command export is not independently identifiable.

charge.fitOnly: bias; fixed V13 dynamics. First120s charging used for fit, remaining samples held out.

lowPowerDawnExtension.clock: Charge dynamics referenced to controller invocation. Discharge dynamics referenced to HA request (fallback: controller plus existing median request latency). Do not add request delay twice.
lowPowerDawnExtension.transition: A single D-to-C event. Existing normal charging delay already brackets observed onset; no additional full-standby 8s gate applies.
lowPowerDawnExtension.diagnosticOnlyInvocations: Maintain controller and actuator state; no command on outputs1..3. Do not use null diagnostic values as zero measurements. Known skips differ from unobserved historical gaps.
lowPowerDawnExtension.uncertainty: 2s data cannot separate transport, physical dynamics and reporting filters. House power is derived. Physical idle contribution, measurement offset and external net load are not independently identified.

closedLoopValidation.decision: Retain current controller. Earlier switching reduces nominal export but worsens import peaks and direction changes in early-cloud sensitivity. Stronger trims are not uniformly better. No physical optimum established.
closedLoopValidation.limitations: Single observed D-to-C transition; active charge commands60..285W. Reconstructed net load and optional reused residual are conditional counterfactual assumptions, not independent predictive evidence. No high-PV or full-battery recalibration.

daylightExtension.scope: Logs17..20, PV284..1789W, normal/high/very-high charging plus one high-PV charge-to-discharge load step. No full-battery or active inhibition event.
daylightExtension.choice: Use new affine local daytime model alongside retained nominal model for current-day studies. Lower RMSE and MAE in logs16..20 holdouts and old log8; slight regression in old log11. No universal replacement of all historical models.

calibration.training: First10min of logs17 and19; chronological remainder plus logs16,18,20 held out. Only gain/bias or continuous hinge at650W fitted. All existing dynamics fixed.

transitionObservations.interpretation: AC-mode confirmation, measured power reversal and PackState have separate observation latencies. PackState must not be used as a physical40s startup gate. No additional gate or generic timer fitted from this single event.

daylightExtension.clockSemantics: Preserve state using execution.invocationSequence for DIAG1. Duplicate or skipped snapshot cycle IDs do not imply a missing controller invocation. Log20 processes the same accepted snapshot twice349ms apart after flow-cycle fallback advances. Repeated samples are not independent observations.
daylightExtension.gridPathUncertainty: Closed-loop tests span separately identified faster grid and delayed battery observation paths, and a coupled signed response. House power is derived; effective grid response is not independently refitted. Both alternatives retained.
daylightExtension.knownSkips: 37 snapshot skips across2398 logged invocations. Hold prior actuator commands; exclude null inputs. No relaxation of450ms builder or1800ms controller limits.

controllerDecision.reason: Faster high-PV ramp reduces export but increases import on PV declines. Stronger trim has small mixed benefits. PV-decline demand ceilings reduce import energy but add export or individual peaks. No candidate selected under import-avoidance priority.

limitations: Conditional counterfactuals using reconstructed net disturbance; reused battery residual is not an independent forecast.
Only one charge-to-discharge event. No claim of physical optimum.
HA observer polling does not establish freshness of the underlying BLE device packet.
Natural solar/load disturbances are not randomized experiments; model alternatives are not probability distributions.
